title: Introducing Timestral
headline: Mistral AI releases Timestral time-series foundation model
summary: Mistral AI has released Timestral, a family of four time-series foundation models ranging from 5M to 209M parameters. The models deliver probabilistic, multivariate forecasts and support past and future covariates while operating efficiently on standard CPUs without requiring a GPU. Mistral provides deployment options including on-prem, VPC, and air-gapped environments alongside fine-tuning capabilities via Mistral Forge.
why_it_matters: Organisations can deploy these lightweight models locally or in air-gapped environments, enabling secure forecasting for sensitive operational and financial data without relying on cloud-based APIs.

quotes.text: Today, we’re releasing Timestral, our first family of time-series foundation models.
The full pipeline can be deployed on our clients’ hardware, including air-gapped environments.

classification.significance_reason: Release of a new time-series foundation model architecture with local/air-gapped deployment capability, relevant to technical assurance and operational risk practitioners.
